environment.description: Same Flask OAuth service deployed on ECS Fargate with a custom task-level Linux parameters configuration. The container's linuxParameters specify a custom seccomp profile loaded from S3 (s3://infra-security-configs/seccomp/oauth-svc-restricted.json) that operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode for syscall numbers 59 (execve), 101 (ptrace), 41 (socket), 42 (connect), 44 (sendto), and 46 (sendmsg) — with the exception of pre-established connections inherited from the container runtime bootstrap. The task also runs with a read-only root filesystem and drops all capabilities except CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Network egress is restricted via a security group that only permits TCP/443 to the OAuth provider's IP range (203.0.113.0/24) and the VPC CIDR for internal services.
